# Themes from other repositories

These themes were imported from other repositories. Each license allows it. Each theme's `meta.json` and `README.md` name its author and source.

| Source | Commit | License | Themes here | Changed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [dracula/t3code](https://github.com/dracula/t3code) | `9094377` | MIT, Copyright (c) 2023 Dracula Theme | `dracula` | Nothing in the colours. |
| [LuiiHer/t3code-themes](https://github.com/LuiiHer/t3code-themes) | `11c698c` | MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 LuiiHer | `vertical`, `vertical-frost` | Gallery-only fields moved to `meta.json`. |
| [soya-miruku/t3code-themes](https://github.com/soya-miruku/t3code-themes) | `7ed04e8` | MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 soya-miruku | `nous`, `nous-alt` | Gallery-only fields moved to `meta.json`. |
| [rblalock/t3code-omarchy-themes](https://github.com/rblalock/t3code-omarchy-themes) | `8016895` | MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Rick Blalock; palette credits in `NOTICE` | the 28 `omarchy-*` themes | The sources are VS Code theme files. T3 Code's own import code (`apps/web/src/vscodeThemeImport.ts` of [pingdotgg/t3code](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code) at commit `ef6e05e356`, MIT) turned each into a T3 Code theme, as the app does on import. |

The license text of each source is in its folder here. The previews were made in this repository with `tools/preview.mjs`.

Not imported, because the repository has no license: the gallery [SunkenInTime/t3-themes](https://github.com/SunkenInTime/t3-themes), [Jonathon-Sherrouse/t3code-pixel-quest](https://github.com/Jonathon-Sherrouse/t3code-pixel-quest), [gsimone/poimandres-t3code](https://github.com/gsimone/poimandres-t3code), [celeroncoder/t3code-catppuccin-theme](https://github.com/celeroncoder/t3code-catppuccin-theme), [gerardthehuman/t3-code-themes](https://github.com/gerardthehuman/t3-code-themes). The catalog links to them.

If a theme here is yours and you want it changed or removed, open an issue.
